My plot is very small, only a little more than a fifth of a hectare, so I must use it well to feed my family. I hope to get the FISP coupon this year like many farmers here in Balaka — if I get it, I will use NPK at planting and urea for topdressing. I keep a few goats and chickens so I also carry their manure to the field before the rains, and I intercrop with pigeon pea to help the soil. My wife and I do all the work ourselves; we cannot afford to pay anyone, and the plot is small enough for our hands.
